inj.note: Hamilton was carted off the field in the second quarter and was originally diagnosed with a knee injury. Tests confirmed the torn quad, and Hamilton finished his 2026 season with 16 tackles (eight solo), including 0.5 sacks, and one fumble recovery across seven starts. He logged 42 percent of the defensive snaps for Jacksonville, so his loss creates a big playing-time hole on the defensive line.

news.h: Jaguars DT DaVon Hamilton (quad), S Eric Murray (elbow) out for season
news.d: Jaguars nose tackle DaVon Hamilton and safety Eric Murray both suffered season-ending injuries during Sunday's win over the Colts, coach Liam Coen announced Monday.
